item.title: This week in AI tells — August 10, 2026
item.description: HumanSounding launched: the live trend board, the in-browser draft checker, the Spot the AI quiz, and downloadable instruction files for Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini. • The first autonomous research run added a new rising tell: lighter punctuation with longer, comma-sparse sentences in newer models. • Wikipedia's editor guide now flags Grok-specific vocabulary (causal, empirical, correlate); added to the trend board. • A July 2026 analysis found that among major chatbots only Claude still uses em dashes above the professional human rate; GPT-5.4 now sits below it. • EQ-Bench weights the "not just X, but Y" pattern at 25% of its slop score, with models running far above the human rate (EQ-Bench, Jul 2026).
